figurative_meaning_en: To completely submit or accept total subjugation
example_sentences_in_bangla: চাষীরা মহাজনের কাছে মাথা বিকিয়ে বসে আছে।
সে তার বসের সামনে মাথা বিকিয়ে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The farmers have sold their heads to the moneylender.
He has completely submitted to his boss.
history: This idiom originates from the historical agrarian economy of Bengal, where impoverished farmers would symbolically 'sell their heads' to moneylenders (mahajans) as a pledge of total servitude to repay debts, reflecting exploitative feudal systems under colonial and pre-colonial rule.
note: The idiom highlights the vulnerability of rural debtors in traditional Bengali society.
